title: demo9：十轮独立实验（七种候选方法＋三轮独立诊断）

common_contract.execution: Exactly 10 independent experiment cards: 7 candidate algorithms + 3 diagnostic/control/stress rounds. No default sequential queue and no prerequisite pass/fail chain. A card may invoke its prepared references directly or reuse lawful frozen outputs without any prior card having run.
common_contract.scope: E1-E7 are seven distinct candidate algorithms. E8-E10 are tests, not invented eighth/ninth/tenth algorithms. The retired collection-mode M1 is unrelated to E1. Archived demo8 graph propagation (56.26 vs56.06) is only an E8 cheap control; absent new measured information it is not reopened as a candidate.
common_contract.data: Freeze one standard official COCO-20i development manifest before inference: NumPy/common episode seed0, 400 standard draws/fold, metadata-only first two draws/class =40 episodes/fold. Every algorithm/control uses exactly the same support/query IDs for its selected cohort. The first10 is an interface subset inside the fixed cohort, not a separately selected efficacy result. No pool by default.
common_contract.exposure: Unique inference gold is the support mask. Class IDs, donor presence, query masks, candidate correctness and oracle indices are sampler/evaluator metadata, never scorer/encoder/distance/weight inputs. Query GT is opened only after all predictions of the selected fixed method snapshot are frozen. Training labels are permitted only for M3 and its equally supervised controls.
common_contract.isolation: For M3 learned U/control training, held-out classes and every support/query/view-source photo must be disjoint across train/dev/test. Canonical COCO numeric image IDs deduplicate train/val aliases. Fix galleries first, then purge whole overlapping training episodes; do not redraw test pools or condition the purge on prediction emptiness. Same-RGB concept-switch paired tasks and repeated views stay in one split/component.
common_contract.numeric: Same existing frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16, actual24 layers, 1024-square preprocessing, native BF16 encoder plus explicitly shared FP32 readout statistics. Preserve ordered native SQ batch2 and declared support-flip batch1 contexts; never deduplicate pair-dependent features by photo. Fit/adaptation may have a separately declared support-only context, equal for its matched control. No FP16 cached replay substituted for native baseline. No-op implementations must reproduce deterministic host masks exactly; transformed algorithms disclose their actual precision. Each input-view/prompt method explicitly records its own support-fitting batch context; never calls B1 and B2 feature differences a method gain without its matched kernel context control.
common_contract.metric: Save method native1024 binary masks or packed bits and per-episode model-size I/U. Original-HxW I/U is a separate binary-bilinear resize (>0.5, align_corners=False) record. Aggregate each class as sumI/sumU, then macro-average classes/folds; never rename mean patch IoU as native classmIoU. Report pixel-ledger recoveredFN/lostTP/addedFP/removedFP.
common_contract.uncertainty: Future method score needs all four folds and an independent frozen cohort/seed after development decisions. Primary paired uncertainty uses truly independent all-role photo components; episode/class bootstrap is sensitivity only if images are shared. A few components or an underpowered pilot is inconclusive, not a universal failure. Methods are not refit inside a conditional frozen-output bootstrap unless explicitly declaring refit uncertainty.
common_contract.useful_effect: Direction is predicted; no new numeric gain forecast is invented. An engineering test requires exact contract/no leakage. The later useful-effect target is >=2 percentage points paired native classmIoU over the strongest matched same-information/budget control, with an interval excluding0; this is a decision target, not an expected result. Ten interface samples or 40 development samples cannot certify it. Project expansion target is >=5pp over the strong full pipeline or a substantial measured quality-cost improvement; +2pp is only a proposed mechanism-screening target, never a CVPR acceptance guarantee. Failure to detect a small effect in40cases is inconclusive unless its valid interval rules out the useful effect.
common_contract.oracle: Only an evaluator may use GT after output freezing. If a finite candidate/view/output bank is actually saved, GT selection is a diagnostic scoped to that bank and metric. Per-episode IoU argmax is not a strict classmIoU upper bound; no oracle is supplied as an inference candidate.
common_contract.resources: Local CPU/source preparation; no GPU rental, CUDA initialization or training on real data. Existing remote source files may be read without executing a model. Future cards are selected independently and require renewed source/asset preflight. No default ten-card queue, no retired-cache reconstruction, no new model/data download; >=5GiB disk reserve, finite timeout and poweroff guard.
common_contract.future_stop_policy: Future owned stage failure, contract violation, OOM or timeout stops only owned process group; if no ready executable next authorized work, invoke provider-aware poweroff after foreign/unknown GPU-owner check. No filler GPU work and no automatic retry/strength/layer/threshold sweep. Shutdown requested is not billing-stop confirmation.
common_contract.novelty: All algorithms are hypotheses or adaptations until strong controls establish task value. Borrowed SAFR, FROST density, SCML metric bases, prompt adaptation, diffusion, OT and view alignment are not novelty claims. Full methods and component adaptations are labelled separately.

cards.algorithm_or_test: 原生每层Q/K/V与后续hidden完全照常；只在旁路以pre-RoPE q_p·k_g替换PG列、PP logits保持原式，所有key共用softmax。CF输出经相同attention输出norm/projection、LayerScale和RSRM outputnorm；24层SAFR权重仅由原生support+support flip决定，三臂共用每图原生尺度。主输出是CF raw融合接无last-layer APD的FROST式连续解码；原生轨迹和query几何冻结，不用硬簇统一标签。

prediction_card.assumption: 直接PG位置相位影响当层读取的有用内容；不改后续轨迹也能改善当前目标/背景证据。

cards.title: 跨图训练方向字典＋参考反例低秩度量
cards.algorithm_or_test: 冻结原生去偏feature坐标，保存/固定同一补空间basis；rank32正交U通过独立图像的训练episode学习。每任务仅support Gold构造balanced局部同标签/困难反例triplets，冻结邻居，最多4096组；strictly-convex Newton得到v，解析步长给w∈[1/4,4]并保护原可靠support margin。M=I+U diag(w-1)Uᵀ，显式平方距离不再L2normalize。query读出采用H0+beta*tau*(logdensity_M-logdensity_I)，同宿主H0保留，w=1严格no-op；外层balanced BCE+softIoU训练U与全局有界beta=4sigmoid(b)，训练query GT合法、测试query GT禁止。 λ/κ/T/tau与宿主score尺度必须以训练/开发协议预先冻结并记录；不能把未定义常数交给测试集或让FROST再白化抵消已学M。 beta是训练/开发数据拟合的宿主特定融合尺度，同监督控制有相同拟合机会，不能称为校准后验或自然同单位相加。Newton必须达到stationarity，custom隐式VJP和活动保护步长都在outer梯度链中。
controls: 同标签/训练预算的SCML式rank-one字典＋任务尺度（取消独立新机制主张）
同预算固定学习度量U,w_global
同宿主、同scale的FROST参考协方差density增量

prediction_card.assumption: 跨图训练得到的差异方向可迁移；support正例/背景反例决定任务尺度比固定度量更有用。
prediction_card.prediction: support margin改善只有在查询净收益超过固定度量与SCML式同监督控制时才有意义；目标>=2pp，无实测预测。保护约束预计代数成立，不保证query精确率。
prediction_card.pass_decision: 只保留真正超越同监督强控制的组成；记录训练/类别照片隔离和额外监督成本，再独立泛化验证。
prediction_card.fail_decision: 求解或outer gradient错先修；保护alpha近0/fit失败只否定当前字典/训练，不能称信息不存在；support拟合好但query不增停止本适配，禁止更长support优化或解禁保护。

cards.cost_cap_stop: 未来训练预先冻结240跨图train tasks、<=50 epochs/3600s；推理固定40任务<=1500s；rank32参数约D×32，block patch distances，fraction<=.3。相同预算训练全部监督控制；达到cap未拟合记inconclusive。不得随机U冒充完成模型。
cpu_readiness: FP64梯度/Hessian/density与SPD/保护界
through-Newton与active-step outer gradient finite-difference
w1宿主输出exact、score tau尺度明确
train/dev/test类别和全部照片角色隔离

cards.title: 相同 RGB 的参考概念切换与无标签错误归因
cards.algorithm_or_test: 固定8组same-support/query RGB的两概念support-mask任务对，加8组support-BG反事实任务对；每对两task、共16 paired units/32 tasks。双方共享RGB、view来源、骨干、预算；仅合法supportmask及其派生证据不同。若读出本来有finite候选bank，两task固定共享同一bank；连续方法不人为加bank。所有方法/控制参数在进fixture前冻结；可直接调用任何已准备冻结接口或加载合法同fixture输出，无需E1-E8先运行。查询semantic PNG仅在输出冻结后用于TP/FP/FN语义归因、unannotated背景比例、概念目标IoU及正确switch评价。
controls: 同RGB、冻结supportmask的无概念响应对照
完整native强方法在相同fixture上
每个冻结候选自带的同预算/同监督控制

prediction_card.assumption: 真实参考条件化应能在相同RGB中按指定概念正确切换；查询错误的语义/空间来源需要数据核验，不能把相似度或响应变化当正确理解。
prediction_card.prediction: 预计合法mask变化至少改变相应判断，但是否正确未知。score变化/argmax变化不代替两个目标的实际IoU；统计错误来源不预设person/ramp/water标签。无增益数字预测。
prediction_card.pass_decision: 保留具体方法使用参考并带来净收益的有界证据，指出错误类别/标注背景来源；不把诊断成功称新方法或自动启动后续round。
prediction_card.fail_decision: 不能正确switch则撤回该冻结方法的条件化主张；semantic PNG的label0只能称未标注背景，不能猜对象身份。缺fixture/接口标NA，不按GT替换有利案例。

cards.cost_cap_stop: 未来固定16paired units，最多32预测/每method（共享native调用可复用但写实际预算），wall1800s/冻结method、fraction<=.3。所有mask/背景变换先CPU准备；当前NO_CARD不调用GPU。

cards.title: 每种冻结方法的质量—成本和跨域压力
cards.algorithm_or_test: 独立manifest冻结24任务：COCO-20i8任务（每任务identity和固定全图色彩/模糊扰动，改变不使用queryGT）；现有SUIM8任务；现有Pascal-Part8任务。每个输入的support/query/view使用该方法已冻结的合法处理，同预算控制获得相同扰动/视图。仅审阅准备好的固定接口或同fixture冻结输出，未准备方法标NA；不等待其他卡先通过。分别报告各数据集实际任务语义、classmIoU/两种分辨率、错误像素、encoder calls、训练/优化成本、concurrent wall time与allocated/reserved峰值；不把不同数据集宏均值拼成单一COCO score。
controls: 完整强参照在相同输入语义/扰动/预算下
每个方法自己的同信息/训练/view预算廉价替代
identity同fixture输出（扰动前后配对）

prediction_card.assumption: 有用改进不仅适配一个开发类/候选bank，还应在显式成本和有限域外/观测扰动下保持净任务价值。
prediction_card.prediction: 泛化/成本排序未知。期待可解释的quality-cost增量而非额外计算带来的表面胜利；后续有用效果目标仍>=2pp over matched strong control，但本24-task压力卡不能证明跨域总体效果。
prediction_card.pass_decision: 保留每method各自有净价值、成本明确的结论并限定数据集/扰动；据此决定独立确认实验，不自动排队。
prediction_card.fail_decision: 某域净退化就撤回该域主张；超预算则记资源不可评估/停止该实现，不调测试域阈值/图像大小/步数挽救。其它独立方法仍可单独审阅。
